blocks.text:
Private City Tour
 Breakfast at the hotel. At the scheduled time, enjoy a private guided tour of Uruguay’s capital.
 Visit Independence Square, the Citadel Gate, Solís Theatre, Executive Tower, Estevez Palace, Salvo Palace, and the monument to national hero José Gervasio Artigas.
 Continue along 18 de Julio Avenue to the Legislative Palace.
 Visit the historic Montevideo Agricultural Market, offering local products and artisan goods.
 Proceed to Batlle y Ordóñez Park to see the Centenario Stadium and the iconic “La Carreta” monument.
 Drive along Montevideo’s coastal boulevard from Pocitos to the famous Montevideo Sign.
 Return to the hotel. Overnight.

blocks.text:
Bouza Winery Experience with Lunch
 Breakfast at the hotel.
 Depart for Bouza Winery, one of Uruguay’s most renowned boutique vineyards.
 Explore the winery and vineyards, and enjoy a three-course lunch, each dish paired perfectly with selected wines.
 Return to the hotel at the agreed time. Overnight.
